blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Public prosecutor and San Juan Rep. Ysabel Maria Zamora has called out people on social media attacking her with sexist and misogynistic remarks, saying that they should “get a life” if they cannot handle her sass and style. In a press briefing on Tuesday, Zamora was asked about online remarks about how she conducted the direct examination of P/Maj. Joericson Sangalang, head of the Philippine National Police Firearms and Explosives Office (PNP-FEO), during Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial. Several individuals have accused Zamora of being “flirtatious” and “acting cute” when she did the examination of Sangalang — a matter […]...
